text: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) utilizes Strathmore Boulevard and Linnsmore Crescent to operate its transit service on Greenwood Avenue, City Council approval of this report is required. Greenwood Station, located on the southwest corner of Strathmore Boulevard and Linnsmore Crescent, is being made accessible as part of the Easier Access Project. Greenwood Station is being equipped with an at grade elevator attached to the existing station building, which will provide accessibility from the eastbound platform to street level, and a below grade elevator that will provide accessibility from the westbound platform to the concourse level. Construction will be undertaken in several phases, with varying degrees of sidewalk and lane closures taking place at the intersection of Strathmore Boulevard and Linnsmore Crescent.
